comprar.verPedido: See what your order would look like

pasos.d: In the assistant you use buttons to choose your budget, the days, how many people you are and your cooking time. For example: €25 for four days.
The AI groups the products by seller, explains why it suggests each one and compares the total with your budget. The decision is yours.
Remove, change or add products and ask for substitutes. The total is recalculated and we warn you if you go over budget.
A single cart with products from several sellers and one total. Before paying you see ingredients and allergens.
Received → collected from the seller → at the hub → packed → out for delivery → delivered.
Reminders of what to eat first, ideas to use everything up and your next shop ready.

comprar.verRecorrido: See the full journey, step by step (10 steps)

recorrido.d: You reach the home page and choose "I want to buy".
It asks for your budget, days, preferences, restrictions and cooking time. Allergies are optional and would only be used during the session.
The AI groups the basket by seller, with quantities, the total against your budget and the reason for each product. It is a suggestion: you decide.
You remove, change or add products, ask for substitutes and open the seller's page. The total is recalculated and you are warned if you go over budget.
A single cart grouped by seller and one total. Minimum order and delivery cost, to be defined.
Summary by seller, area and delivery slot, ingredients and allergens in view and acceptance of the terms. Perishable goods have no right of withdrawal.
Received, collected from the seller, at the hub (consolidation and checks), packed, out for delivery and delivered.
Reminders of what to eat first, ideas to use up what you bought and your next shop ready. Expiry alerts need real batch data.
A simple form if something arrives in poor condition. Who responds (seller, FOOD4ALL or both) is to be defined.
Delivery benefits and promotions, with no compulsory boxes. Coming soon, no prices yet.

pasos.d: Fill in the form with your business, area, health registration and collection times.
We check that you meet the minimum standards. You will see the status: received, under review, verified or rejected.
Every product needs a complete listing: origin, price, unit, ingredients, allergens, date type and storage.

pasos.t: Receive your part of the order
pasos.d: You only see your products, quantities and collection slot. You confirm or report a shortage.

pasos.t: Prepare it and we collect it
pasos.d: You leave it ready with the order and batch number. FOOD4ALL collects it from you; you do not handle shipping.
We check the product against the order. If something does not meet the standard, it is removed and you are told.
You see your sales and the FOOD4ALL commission.

ganas.titulo: One more channel, without handling deliveries

beneficios.d: You reach people who plan their shopping and look for local produce.
Your business appears alongside other sellers in your area, with its own page.
You keep selling as always; FOOD4ALL adds orders, it does not replace them.
We collect from you and deliver. You only prepare your part.

comunidad.entradilla: FOOD4ALL is not just a shop: we want to bring together people who cook, people who produce and people who are learning to organise their meals. Recipes, seasons and tips, on our social media.

publicaciones.t: One pot of lentils, four meals sorted
A day at a neighbourhood bakery

porQue.titulo: Without community, local does not work
porQue.texto: A local produce marketplace depends on trust and word of mouth more than on advertising. That is why the community has been part of the project from day one, not an add-on.

razones.d: Someone starting to cook away from home learns more from a real recipe, on a real budget, than from any guide.
Knowing who grows or bakes what you buy is the basis of trust in local food.
Ideas to use up leftovers and what to eat first: together we cut waste.
What the community asks for and thinks guides what we build next. Many decisions are still open.

pilares.texto: Useful content to eat better with little time and a small budget. How often we post is to be defined.

listaNormas: Respect in the comments: this is a place to learn to cook, not to judge.
No hidden advertising: sponsored content is always labelled as such.
Allergies are taken seriously: every recipe lists its allergens.
No health promises or miracle diets.
